title: Geometric restriction and coefficient transport
statement: Let $(C,J)$ be a small site with pullbacks, let $s:C\simeq C$ have both directions continuous, let $R$ be a commutative ring sheaf, and let $a:(s^{-1})^*R\simeq R$. Use the Site, module translation $\sigma$, and fixed-pair definitions of [def-sf-twisted-action-presentation-data]. For a specified $S:\operatorname{Site}(J,s,R,a)$ whose inclusion is cocontinuous, there is a ringed-topos morphism from $(\operatorname{Sh}(C,J),R)$ to $(\operatorname{Sh}(S.\mathrm{topology}),S.\mathrm{coefficient})$ with set inverse image literally precomposition by inclusion and structural ring map equal to the coefficient restriction after transport through that inverse-image equality. This ring map is invertible. Ordinary module restriction with the prescribed coefficient transport is left adjoint to its module direct image. No fixed-pair presentation is asserted.

proof.text: Apply the existing continuous-cocontinuous ringed restriction theorem to the coefficient ring. It supplies set and module adjunctions for the literally restricted ring and a sectionwise heterogeneous identity for its ring map. Equality induction and sheaf-morphism extensionality identify this map with transport through the inverse-image equality.

Transport the source ring by the coefficient restriction isomorphism. Postcompose the structural map with that isomorphism, and precompose the module direct image with scalar restriction along it. Sectionwise ring-map laws prove the four generalized-element identities; the original module-linearity identity is unchanged under the transported scalar action. On the identity site Mathlib pushforwardPushforwardEquivalence makes scalar restriction an equivalence. Compose the original module adjunction with its inverse-equivalence adjunction. This gives the requested ordinary restriction adjunction and the precise structural formula. All these operations are implemented in the private proved helpers, with no existence axiom or unproved property.

theorem geometricRestriction [HasPullbacks C] (S : Site J s R a) :
    letI := S.category
    letI := S.inclusion_continuous
    S.inclusion.IsCocontinuous J S.topology →
    ∃ (g : RingedToposMorphism (ring R) (ring S.coefficient))
      (h : g.inverse = S.inclusion.sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type u) J S.topology),
      IsIso g.ringMap ∧
      g.ringMap =
        (eqToHom h).app ((sheafCompose S.topology (forget RingCat)).obj
          (ring S.coefficient)) ≫
          (sheafCompose J (forget RingCat)).map
            ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map
              S.coefficientRestriction.hom) ∧
      Nonempty (SheafOfModules.pushforward
        ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map
          S.coefficientRestriction.inv) ⊣ g.modules)
